howItWorks.title: From supplier research to quote follow-up
howItWorks.description: A good heat exchanger quotation starts with clear operating conditions. The request form helps buyers turn project details into a format that a sourcing specialist can review and follow up on.

steps.title: Research supplier fit
steps.body: Use manufacturer and product pages to understand factory capability, application sectors, and available trust signals.

steps.title: Prepare technical context
steps.body: Enter media, phases, mass flow, temperatures, materials, pressure, flange standards, heat load, and notes.

steps.title: Verify your email
steps.body: No account registration is required. A verifiable email helps confirm the request is real and supports follow-up.

steps.title: Get specialist follow-up
steps.body: The HeatEx Direct team reviews the request, checks for missing parameters, and follows up around suitable supplier discussions.
